## ⚠️ Important

**For critical or high-severity vulnerabilities, do NOT use this template.**
Instead, report privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/evoveotech/testreport-forge/security/advisories/new) or email security@evoveo.tech.

See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the full disclosure policy.

## Severity

- [ ] Low -- minimal impact, requires specific conditions
- [ ] Medium -- could affect some users under certain conditions
- [ ] High -- affects many users or has significant impact
- [ ] Critical -- allows data access, code execution, or service disruption
